answerKeyCaveat: IMPORTANT: TEA also publishes '2023-staar-science-grade-8-answer-key.pdf' (data-reports domain), but on inspection its Appendix content (sodium sulfate formula, Hertzsprung-Russell drag-and-drop, block-sliding-friction free response, 5-element metal/nonmetal/metalloid table) does NOT match this Practice Assessment PDF's actual item content (sun/star facts, cell theory, density-of-wood-sample, hurricane formation, etc.) despite both being labeled Grade 8 Science items 1-38. That key belongs to a different underlying item set (likely the current online test form, which reuses the STAAR item bank differently than this legacy-style PDF practice form). Treat this source the same as the NY Social Studies 2006 batch and STAAR G5 Science 2022 batch: NO verified official key exists for these specific items. Correct answers below were derived by direct science-content reasoning (grade-8-level physics/chemistry/biology/earth-space science), not copied from any key. Flagged for extra human scrutiny per README.md's precedent for sources lacking a matching answer key.
